Plan your visit · Organic Spa Pedicure

Organic Spa is a defined 50-minute pedicure—not a generic luxury label.

For a Biltmore guest who wants more than essential grooming, Organic Spa is the clearest everyday spa decision. It is distinct from both the shorter Classic and Deluxe options and the longer Pearl, Jelly, CBD, and Gold rituals. Add gel removal and the new finish when applicable, then reserve before heading to the verified salon on 16th Street.

Review Organic Spa →

Your appointment destination

What to know before visiting from Biltmore.

Appointments from Biltmore take place at 6022 N 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85016. Call 602-607-5686 if you need help selecting a service or planning a group visit. The salon is open Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–7 PM and Sunday 10 AM–5 PM; available booking times may end earlier. Free on-site parking is available. Check the current menu and booking flow for service choices and starting prices.
